propositions: The module-size gate step aborts with exit 1 when the allowlist is empty (contains only comments) because grep returns exit 1 on no match, which under bash -e and pipefail terminates the step before the over-cap check runs
The gate must accept a fully-drained (comment-only) allowlist and complete successfully with 'Module-size gate: OK' and exit 0 when there are no over-cap files
Both gerrit-verify.yaml and test.yml contain an identical unguarded listed= grep line that must be wrapped with '|| true' to suppress the no-match exit code
The fix must land on main before the allowlist-emptying change (reconcile.py) can pass Verified, since the gate runs from main's workflow against each change's tree
The gate must preserve existing behavior for non-empty allowlists and still fail when a non-allow-listed file exceeds 800 LOC
